question: In a certain code language, 'THRICE' is written as 'TRIHEC' and 'SECTOR' is written as 'TSROEC'. How will 'JOYFUL' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'THRICE' is written as 'TRIHEC'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b84eda5ac5a67e9b41c84118d7e7b13a97f6712896c2a00e782d453be7efae4a.png] And,

'SECTOR' is written as 'TSROEC'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d79568063f126f79b5e44cf8a7b50a64e56708a42bb8f4852c5b5a339af996b7.png] Similarly,

'JOYFUL' will be written as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92fbffe060f3d17a655460cddcf079efa378b4a7c4beb359dc50c33d7832e05c.png] Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
